elements.text: Atlas Bikes | C-3 Specification rev. 5 | Internal
The C-3 frame is aluminum with an internal battery tube. The cargo version adds a reinforced rear rack that covers the top of the rear wheel.

Scope: C-3, 36 V battery pack, frame-mounted, standard charger.

rows: Check that the battery serial number matches the delivery note.
Inspect the battery casing for cracks or dents.
Check that the charging port cover closes fully.
Measure the resting voltage and write it on the delivery sheet.
Charge the battery to at least 50 percent before delivery.

elements.text: Atlas Bikes | C-3 Specification rev. 5 | Internal

rows: Check that the battery lock engages and the key turns freely.
Replace the battery seal wherever the casing has been opened.
Keep the battery vent holes clear of tape and stickers.
Record the battery batch number in the bike's service record.
Report any battery fault found during the final check.
Complete the battery safety sign-off before handing over the bike.

elements.text: Each bike carries a label with the model, frame number, and battery type. Cargo versions add a label with the maximum rack load.
The C-3 uses the 36 V battery pack BP-36-2, mounted in the frame's battery tube. Capacity: 540 Wh.
